G-05.change: In _resolve_entry_point() (line 230): when finding has 'store_entry_point_id', resolve both store EP and load EP. In _check_auth_consistency() (line 627): use write-leg (store EP) auth level — not load-leg — to determine attacker access severity. In _check_guard_consistency() (line 664): check guards on BOTH legs (store-leg needs nonce/cap, load-leg needs output escaping). Factor write-leg auth level into severity scoring.
